head: codex/19-podcast-preview-deployment
title: [v0.92][WP-24A deployment] Deploy the podcast page to the preview URL
body:
Closes #19

Deploys the Synthetic Minds podcast preview through the existing Agent Logic S3 and CloudFront website infrastructure. The page is now static HTML using only same-origin assets, native audio controls, and native FAQ controls, with no framework runtime, scripts, external fonts, or EC2/compute operations.

Validation:
- repository podcast launch packet: PASS
- retained deployment evidence and exact live digest parity for HTML, RSS, WAV, and logo: PASS
- desktop and mobile browser proof: no console errors, no horizontal overflow, native audio ready
- production /podcast/ route remains HTTP 403 and preview retains noindex,nofollow
- independent exact-head review: APPROVE with no actionable findings

Five unreferenced diagnostic S3 objects are disclosed in the evidence and intentionally retained pending explicit deletion authorization.
